hooks.prompt: Run security-review on the pending changes before this push completes. Check for: credential leaks, injection vulnerabilities, insecure crypto, exposed secrets in configs. Block with exit code 2 if critical issues found.

hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; echo "Testing changes in $f"; } 2>/dev/null || true
